title: Two-floor elevator with door interlock
nl_spec: Control a two-floor elevator car as a state machine: 0 = At-bottom, 1 = Moving-up, 2 = At-top, 3 = Moving-down. A CallUp request (at the bottom) starts moving up; on reaching the top limit (AtTop) the car stops at the top. A CallDown request (at the top) starts moving down; on reaching the bottom limit (AtBottom) it stops at the bottom. Two motor outputs drive the car: MotorUp and MotorDown. A door sensor DoorClosed (TRUE = closed) is provided. SAFETY-CRITICAL: the car must never move while the door is open (motors are inhibited unless DoorClosed); the two motors must never run together; and the car must not drive past an end limit (no up at AtTop, no down at AtBottom). Use an internal INT State (0..3). Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named elevator with inputs CallUp, CallDown, DoorClosed, AtTop, AtBottom and outputs MotorUp, MotorDown.

safety_properties.nl: The two motors never run at the same time.
The car never moves while the door is open.
The car never drives up past the top limit.
The car never drives down past the bottom limit.

scenarios.description: Call up, travel, stop at top
Door opening mid-travel inhibits the motor
At bottom, a down call does not move the car

notes: Motor outputs are gated on DoorClosed AND not-at-limit directly in the output mapping, guaranteeing the door-interlock and limit safety regardless of state.
